# Cortex

> Cortex is an AI service for Roblox game developers. It lets a Roblox game call a neural net with one server-side HTTP request — for talking NPCs, adaptive quests, generated item/lore text, and chat moderation. The API key stays server-side (never in the client). Payment is in Robux via a game pass. Currently in free open beta.

## What it does
- Talking NPCs / characters that reply in-character to what players type
- Adaptive quests and missions
- Generated item names, lore, and descriptions
- Chat moderation by meaning (not a word list)
- In-game assistants and guides

## How to use it (server Script only)
```lua
local Cortex = require(game.ServerStorage.Cortex)
local ai = Cortex.new("YOUR_KEY")
print(ai:ask("You are a gruff blacksmith. One short line.", "forge me a sword?"))
```
One HTTP request, ~3 seconds. Turn on Allow HTTP Requests in Game Settings → Security.

## Key facts
- Tiers: osa-fast, osa-smart, osa-cheap, osa-auto
- Pricing: free during beta; then pay in Robux (no credit card)
- Security: your key never touches the client — calls are made from a server Script
